choices.reason: Neither candidate is explicitly designated primary. The abstract and introduction emphasize the disappearance of the creativity deficit under co-creation as the Study 2 finding, identifying co-creator versus unassisted human as the emphasized contrast, while attributing the editor-versus-human finding to Study 1.
choices.locator: PDF p. 1, abstract, sentence beginning "Following this"; also p. 2, final introduction paragraph before Results.
choices.quote: Following this, we demonstrate that this creativity deficit dissipates when people co-create with—not edit—AI and establish creative self-efficacy as an important mechanism in this process (Study 2).
